utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, 7:30 still works for me. Eli’s doing the pickup for Dane and Nora, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Jules will make sure everyone’s on the same page, and I’ll pass the carpool plan along too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks — as long as 7:30’s still the plan, I’m good.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oren, the weekday carpool is around 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m. Rosa’s organizing it, and Sam is picking Mina up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — that lines up with my notes. Rosa still needs to confirm the pickup spot and time for the 8:15 carpool for Mina and me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll wait for Rosa to confirm the pickup spot and the 8:15 time for you and Mina.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — 8:15 works for the carpool, and I’ll help keep everyone on the same page. Vik can pass it along to the group so the plan stays consistent.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll send the rider groups later too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks — that should keep everyone synced up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I can take Tuesdays and Thursdays, and Bo can cover the other days. The 8:15 carpool for Mina and Opal is all set, and Bo’ll keep an eye out for my text.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — Eli’s picking up me and Nora, right? I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, Eli’s got you and Nora covered. Thanks — I’ll text if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll check the pickup time and let Nell know once Bo sends the rider groups over. Tomorrow’s carpool is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, it’s still at 8:15, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, 8:15 sounds right. I’ll confirm it once Bo sends the rider groups and then let Nell know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s still set for 8:15, and I’ll make sure Rey stays posted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll fill Dane in and lend a hand if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’ll keep Rey posted, and it looks like Eli has Dane and Nora at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:15 works for me, and I can do pickup after school on Monday and Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll handle picking Mina up for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Sam — that helps a lot. I’ll keep 3:15 on my side and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll pick up Dane and Nora at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that sounds good if the timing and pickup spots work for everyone. Let me know once Quinn has the details set and Rey can stay in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll stick with 7:15 for Dane and Nora, and I’ll wait for Quinn’s details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I’m in the carpool, and I’ll send the groups over. If you have the time again, Mara can text it to me too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good — 7:30 still works for the weekday carpool, and I can text you if needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks — 7:30 works for me. I’ll send the groups over, and if I forget the time again, Mara can text it to me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. Tess will keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll keep my phone handy and pass along the pickup time as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — just let me know when you hear the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll let Faye know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send the carpool schedule and loop Eli in if anyone else wants a ride.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send it over and I’ll keep Faye posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you remind me if Ira texts when they’re on the way?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — I can text everyone the carpool plan, and if Ira is on the way, I’ll make sure Mina hears about it. We’re still meeting at 8:00 a.m. in the church parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — and just to confirm, Ira covers Tuesdays and Thursdays, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Okay, Eli can grab Nora and me. I’ll be ready when he gets here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got Mina for the carpool, so we’re all set on my end.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, sounds like we’re covered then. I’ll keep an eye out for Eli.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still at 8:15, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s still 8:15. Rosa is confirming the pickup spot and will send the exact details once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — 8:15 it is, then?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s covering today’s carpool, Bo or Ira?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s Opal and you in the carpool today. Vik will pass the plan along so everyone gets the same info.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you have Vik tell me the pickup time too?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help on some weekdays around 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m. If you need, I can repeat the times for Oren too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m. works. I’ll let Faye know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Leo — that should work well. And I’m happy to repeat the times for Oren if needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll keep my phone handy, and once Cleo tells me the pickup time, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should help keep things organized. Once Quinn has the timing and pickup spots set, Rey can stay in the loop, and Tess can let Rey know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll wait for Cleo’s update and share the pickup time as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 7:30 still works for me on weekdays. I’m glad we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good to me—7:30 weekdays works, and I’ll keep it simple too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, then we’re set for weekdays at 7:30. Thanks, Bo—I'll keep it simple too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m just checking the carpool time before I confirm it to Kira. Once that’s set, we can make sure Jules and Vik have the clear plan, and I’ll use Faye’s pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s still at 8:15. I can fill Dane in and lend a hand if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — 8:15 works, and I’ll confirm it to Kira now. If you can fill Dane in, that would help keep everyone aligned.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:15 still works for me, and I can handle pickup after school on Monday and Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll note 3:15 and check the pickup time with Nell. I’ll let her know, and keep your name on the carpool list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo. Just keep me posted if anything shifts, and I’m set for Monday and Wednesday pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s still set for 8:15, and I’ll keep Rey posted. Also, Eli has Dane and Nora at 7:15, so I’ll make sure that gets passed along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just a quick correction: the carpool is set for 8:00 a.m. at the church parking lot. I’ll make sure everyone has the updated plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the update — 8:00 a.m. at the church parking lot, got it. I’ll pass that along to Rey and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Tuesdays and Thursdays work for me, and Bo can handle the other days. The 8:15 for Mina and Opal is set, and I’ll text when I’m on the way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks — I’ll send the groups over. If I forget the time again, Mara can text it to me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — just send the groups when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll send the carpool schedule now and loop Eli in too if anyone else wants a ride.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—thanks. Tess can keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’m sending it out now and I’ll include Eli if anyone else needs a ride.
